kv_bound_semantics: All requests simultaneously resident through maximum output, 16-token pages at 2 MiB/page; upper bound, not measured occupancy. Excludes one null page.

temporal_overlap_diagnostic.rule: Preserve source arrivals i/100 for indices 0..255; use 30+(i-256)*0.2 for indices 256..319.
temporal_overlap_diagnostic.split_basis: Existing 256-request knee prefix; final 64-request length-stratum phase.
temporal_overlap_diagnostic.design_basis: Development design informed by prior aggregate pressure timing; no per-request future outcomes used.
temporal_overlap_diagnostic.semantics: Only external arrival times change. Same IDs/order/prompts and assigned output budgets; not an independent holdout or policy-gain comparison. Ongoing-arrival pressure is not guaranteed.
